title: The Tower of Babel
summary: Pride says we can live without God, but God is still Lord over every nation. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Genesis 11:1-9 and look for how this passage teaches: Pride says we can live without God, but God is still Lord over every nation.

tell_it: The people tried to build a tower to make a name for themselves. God confused their language and scattered them.
understand_it: Pride says we can live without God, but God is still Lord over every nation. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: The Tower of Babel reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Pride matters.
age_8_11_explanation: The Tower of Babel shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: Pride says we can live without God, but God is still Lord over every nation.
teen_explanation: The Tower of Babel gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that pride says we can live without God, but God is still Lord over every nation. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: Pride says we can live without God, but God is still Lord over every nation.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when pride is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: Why did the people build the tower?
choices: To make a name for themselves
quiz_questions.answer: To make a name for themselves
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: To make a name for themselves. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that pride says we can live without God, but God is still Lord over every nation.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Genesis 11:4 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in The Tower of Babel?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Build or Bow
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: Pride says we can live without God, but God is still Lord over every nation.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from The Tower of Babel. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
